**Abstention is a first-class output, not an error state.** The bounded-abstention literature gives a Bayes-optimal rule: abstain where `|η(x)−1/2| < γ_δ`, with a proposed gate of `≥+2.0 pp` hit rate at `δ=0.2` and achieved skip rate within `±3 pp` of `δ` [research/corpus-intelligence/briefs/c07/c07-r09/1006-bounded-abstention-rate-binary.brief.md].

**Variance-gated no-bet**: reject when conditional outcome variance `σ²(x)` exceeds its `(1−ε)`-quantile; proposed gate `ε=0.3`, RMSE drop `≥15%` vs publish-all, achieved rejection rate within `±3 pp` [research/corpus-intelligence/briefs/c01/reader-19/1010_regression_reject_option_knn.brief.md].

**PCMCI+ causal feature pruning** (α=0.01, τmax=4) on a ~30-indicator nflverse panel: held-out Brier within 0.002 of the all-lags baseline using ≤60% of features, edge Jaccard ≥0.5 [research/corpus-intelligence/briefs/c09/c09-r17/arxiv-program__research__2026-09-21__arxiv-deep__1963-pcmci-time-series-causal-discovery.brief.md].

The reasoning layer's edge formula is decomposable: edge = Σ(prior × signed signal) across live families; dark families contribute 0, live families are not scaled up, dark share is 0.24 by design [research/corpus-intelligence/briefs/c10/r57/week3-engine-readings.brief.md].
